authorship: Agent-authored SQLite/ASGI reproduction derived from the documented dependency semantics and public discussion. It is not an upstream application, buyer delivery or a production incident.

docs.scope: Official description of function/request cleanup and streaming session lifetime

first_decision: RETAIN_INCUMBENT: explicit endpoint commit plus request-scoped resource cleanup satisfies both measured obligations. Single-scope failures justify an effect-factorization measurement exercise, not a novel enabling-capability claim.
limitations: Local ASGI send boundary is measured, not real network receipt or distributed durability.
SQLite deferred foreign-key failure is an authored adversarial case. No SQLAlchemy/PostgreSQL or observed customer workflow evaluated.
One valid and one commit-failure case per arm are development probes, not protected statistical confirmation.
Current FastAPI version resolved through free PyPI installation; paid models, subscriptions and customer contact were not used.
Installation/download wall time and monetary research overhead are not measured by the subsecond execution receipt.
